Arcana Famiglia 2 - La Storia della Arca.name: La storia della Arcana Famiglia 2
Arcana Famiglia 2 - La Storia della Arca.summary: Taking a year after the prequel, features Ash from the fandisk and new pickable heroes.

Buzz! Brain of the UK.name: Buzz! Brain of the UK
Buzz! Brain of the UK.summary:
Brace yourself United Kingdom Buzz is back, and he's looking for the brightest quiz fans in the land! Brush up on your national knowledge and prepare to be tested on all the things that make the UK brilliant from movies and music to sport, celebs and much, much more!

A portable quiz bonanza with over 4000 questions!
Compete against friends on one PSP system in Pass Around mode or enjoy four player face-offs via Game Sharing
Face 15 brain-busting rounds in the spectacular solo challenge

Dengeki no Pilot - Tenkuu no Kizuna.name: Dengeki no Pilot: Tenkuu no Kizuna
Dengeki no Pilot - Tenkuu no Kizuna.summary:
Our protagonist Hugo lives a peaceful life, far away from war in a remote country named Portland. One day, Hugo witnesses a plane crash and hurriedly checks for survivors. On board he finds only a single girl, Fiona, who is chased by armed forces.
Hugo, without fully comprehending what is going on, sees himself forced to use his late fathers robot Pirot in order to protect Fiona and flee with her.
Eventually their adventure leads them on board of the floating battleship Starlight.
Thats when the cogwheel of destiny starts to spin.

Despicable Me - The Game.name: Despicable Me: The Game
Despicable Me - The Game.summary: Be Despicable! (It’s fun!) Despicable Me: The Game lets players of all ages experience the thrill of being Gru, one of the world’s greatest supervillains who is planning the biggest heist in history – stealing the moon. Complete heists and missions in a unique blend of action and puzzle solving that combines the fun of commanding minions and using an arsenal of Despicable gadgets and weapons.

Fading Shadows.name: Fading Shadows
Fading Shadows.summary: Fading Shadows is a puzzle game set in a vast real-life world with fantasy elements. Navigate your sphere using the beam of light. You will meet numerous obstacles on your way - reveal ancient writings, set fire, reflect light in the mirrors, and evaporate water. Your sphere can change in substance.

Romeo vs. Juliet.name: Romeo VS Juliet
Romeo vs. Juliet.summary: Romeo vs Juliet was released in 2013 for the PSP. In 2015, it was released on the PSVita in a double pack with its sequel called Romeo VS Juliet All Series Pack.

Sangoku Rensenki - Otome no Heihou!.name: Sangoku Rensenki: Otome no Heihou!
Sangoku Rensenki - Otome no Heihou!.summary: Yamada Hana, a high school girl, woke up and found herself in a strange land after being enveloped by a bright light that came out from a mysterious book. There, Hana met a young man named Gentoku, and ended up staying with him and his army as "Koumei's disciple"…
